annotations.title: Answer a task that was sent back for clarification

description: Use when a task you raised comes back flagged 'needs more info'. Supply the missing goal and definition of done (and optional constraints); the flag clears and the task returns to the queue ready to work.

constraints.description: Optional limits, must-nots, or required inputs.

definition_of_done.description: How a reviewer will know it is finished.

goal.description: What outcome this task must produce.

note.description: Optional message back to whoever sent it back.

task_id.description: Task id, or a pasted Tango task URL.

name: resolve_needs_more_info
